# Reveal.js Chalkboard

Original plugin version 2.3.3 from [Asvin Goel's Reveal.js plugins](https://github.com/rajgoel/reveal.js-plugins/tree/5e5375a830eb8101836c10c1f3b56c71066c458e/chalkboard), pinned to commit `5e5375a830eb8101836c10c1f3b56c71066c458e`.

The plugin, stylesheet, blackboard texture and eraser cursor are copied unchanged. MIT licence in `LICENSE`. The chalk effect credits Mohamed Moustafa's Chalkboard project.

This deck provides its own accessible menu and drawing toolbar in `assets/presenter.js` and `assets/presenter.css`. The plugin's Font Awesome palette and board handle are disabled, so Font Awesome is not required. Pen cursors use the browser's crosshair. Drawings are stored in session storage and can be downloaded from the menu.
